lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the pectoral fin attachment. These blobs are arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows, forming a grid-like constellation across the central flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to create a lattice-like pattern where the blobs serve as the primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high (dorsal-facing edge) to low (ventral-facing edge).

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, more closely packed high-luminance spots relative to the patterning observed on the lateral body flank.
